purpose: Memory hierarchy and attention tiling. Cropped from Dao et al., NeurIPS 2022 Figure 1, page 2; the performance panel is omitted. Hardware labels belong to the source example.[^flash-published]
alt: FlashAttention memory hierarchy and tiling: small fast GPU SRAM sits above larger HBM and CPU DRAM; blocks of K and V and then Q are copied into SRAM, computed there, and the output is written to HBM without storing the full attention-score matrix.
